title: The Hunters' Shrine
text: A shrine of skulls where hunters come to ask the hunt's spirit for luck: deer, boar, bear, wolf, piled up into a little hill, antlers woven together into a roof. Fresh blood on the altar stone. Someone has prayed here very recently.

options.label: The most blooded prays at the shrine of skulls, one hunter to another.

outcomes.text: The hunt's spirit answers, a breath of musk and blood, and luck comes with it.

options.label: Leave an offering on the bloody stone, and ask the spirit for swift feet.

outcomes.text: A little luck, and your feet are quick as deer's for a while.

options.label: Take a skull from the pile. The spirit has so many.

outcomes.text: The spirit is displeased, and the antler roof creaks, and something follows you out. The skull is old and hard as wyrmbone.
